title: Repair worker and event schema contract drift
objective: Stop repeated Swarm control validation failures caused by worker-facing producer conventions drifting from the strict validator: workers emit intuitive lifecycle aliases such as CLAIMING/DONE and immutable REVIEW_RESULT events already carry typed pr/headSha/verdict fields that the current generic event validator rejects. Make the accepted lifecycle/event contract explicit, preserve strict typing and unknown-field fail-closed behavior, and restore live control validity without weakening authoritative claim/resource fencing.
acceptance: the supported canonical worker-status vocabulary is explicitly documented where every Go worker reads it, with only evidence-backed compatibility aliases accepted
CLAIMING and DONE compatibility records validate without changing claim/resource ownership authority, while genuinely unknown worker statuses still fail closed
immutable typed REVIEW_RESULT history using pr/headSha/verdict validates through strict event-specific type/domain checks; unrelated unknown top-level event fields remain rejected
future structured review events have one documented canonical payload shape so producers and validators do not drift again
core and hardening control-plane tests cover worker aliases, typed review events, unknown-status rejection, unknown-event-field rejection, and unchanged claim/resource fencing
live swarm-control validation returns PASS on authoritative history without rewriting immutable events
notes: Generation-2 successor PR #434 exact head 4c73ae7bd82fb7969824bd2cdbfa49346b2dc482 correctly repairs the predecessor REVIEW_RESULT verdict type hole and has canonical CI 31589132728 PASS plus Swarm engine-tests 31589132702 PASS. Independent exact-head review by sol-20260812-s6v3k8r1 published evt-20260812-110330-s6v3k8r1-worker-status-g2-review with REQUEST_CHANGES: validate_worker still performs WORKER_STATUSES set membership before proving status is a string, so JSON []/{} status values raise raw TypeError rather than controlled ControlError; current core/hardening unknown-status coverage uses only FINISHED. GitHub review 4915685995 records the same blocking verdict as COMMENT because the repository-authenticated identity cannot formally request changes on its own PR. Preserve the verdict repair and finite ACTIVE/CLAIMING/DONE aliases; add the analogous worker status string guard plus []/{} regressions, rerun exact-head canonical CI/engine-tests, then request another fresh independent review. pr-ownership remains separately fail-closed on HG-BACKFILL-OBJECTGENOME-STRING-BUDGET legacy dependency shape and must not be bypassed.
blockers: PR #434 needs one narrow worker-schema repair: require worker status to be a string before WORKER_STATUSES membership and add core/hardening []/{} regressions asserting controlled ControlError rejection; preserve finite compatibility aliases and ownership fencing.
After the repair, exact-head canonical CI/engine-tests and a fresh independent review by a worker other than the repairing primary are required.

Repository-wide pr-ownership is separately fail-closed on live swarm-control lane HG-BACKFILL-OBJECTGENOME-STRING-BUDGET because its dependency entry is a legacy string rather than the strict dependency object shape; do not attribute or bypass that shared control-state defect in this candidate.
